purpose: Teach: 帯域/ファクター/環境省/入所/税務署/経済企画庁/自治省/付随

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、通信帯域の暗号化を強化されますね
lines.en: Police strengthen encryption on their communications channels, don't they.
lines.style: Conversational, slightly formal. Light affirmation seeking on the final particle. Steady pace, observational tone—not questioning, confirming shared knowledge.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪発生のファクターを分析されますね
lines.en: Police analyze the factors behind crime occurrence, don't they.
lines.style: Same conversational register. Tone stays level and factual. Slight nod in the voice—acknowledging the breadth of their work without particular emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、環境省と環境犯罪対策で連携されますね
lines.en: Police collaborate with the Environment Ministry on environmental crime countermeasures, don't they.
lines.style: Continuing the same measured cadence. Shows awareness of cross-agency coordination. No surprise in the voice—matter-of-fact, slightly admiring of the scope.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、少年院入所者の更生支援もされますね
lines.en: Police also provide rehabilitation support for juvenile detention residents, don't they.
lines.style: Tone shifts subtly—still cooperative, but with warmth underneath. Gentle acknowledgment of their role in rehabilitation. Slight emphasis on "also"—recognizing the softer side of their work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、税務署と脱税捜査で連携されますね
lines.en: Police work with the Tax Bureau on tax evasion investigations, don't they.
lines.style: Back to factual observational tone. Clean, steady delivery. No judgment—simply stating another facet of their coordination with other agencies.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、経済企画庁OBの経済犯罪事案も扱われますね
lines.en: Police also handle economic crime cases involving former Economic Planning Agency officials, don't they.
lines.style: Slight dryness creeping in—acknowledging the delicate nature of these cases without stating it outright. Measured pace. Tone stays professional but with understated awareness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、自治省関連の天下り事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: Police also respond to cases involving post-retirement positions related to the Local Autonomy Ministry, don't they.
lines.style: A beat of quiet acknowledgment. Tone carries subtle skepticism—aware of the political complexity. Still cooperative in register, but with layers. Slight trailing-off suggests "between us, we know what this really is."

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査本部に付随する分析班も持たれますね
lines.en: Police maintain analysis teams attached to their investigation headquarters too, don't they.
lines.style: Closing statement. Tone becomes more direct, less questioning. A final confirmation with slight weight—impressed by the infrastructure. Steady, clear delivery. Small pause before the final particle.
